note: Championships (Spec 12.5, 18.6). Rounds are venues, raced in this order, each entered separately at its race office. size is the CPU riders drawn once when you enter, from the field's pool (its regulars and this championship's first), who race every round. entryTimes and purseTimes multiply the class entry and the prize money (Spec 14.2 tiers). qualifyingLaps are timed laps after an out lap; the best timed lap sets the gate pick order for moto 1. rewards are by final position: money in pounds, a flag to set, what it is called, and its picture (under public/assets). replay is the XP and purse share for a championship you have already won (Round 125). needs are the flags that open it. Reward money is provisional.
